**File:** `lib/rag.ts`

**Algorithm:** TF-IDF cosine similarity — tokens are lowercased, stopword-filtered, and lightly stemmed; chunks and queries are vectorized using IDF values computed across the whole corpus; scores are cosine similarity. There's also an intent-detection override: if the query contains category keywords (e.g. "projects", "skills"), all chunks of that `kind` get a floor score of 0.5 and are force-included regardless of cosine score.

**What it indexes:** ~15 static chunks built from `data/portfolio.ts` — about/bio, projects (title + description + stack), experiences (title + company + dates + description), education, skills (grouped by domain), and certifications. Titles are duplicated in the vector to upweight title matches. The retrieved chunks are injected as context into a Groq/Llama 3.3-70B chat prompt in `app/api/chat/route.ts`.
